facts.statement: The genus Erromenosteus was first described by Jaekel in 1919.
The type species of the genus is Erromenosteus lucifer.
Erromenosteus has been synonymized with the genera Leiosteus, Paraleiosteus, Coccosteus, and Brachydeirus.
facts.quote: synonyms: Erromenosteidae Obruchev, 1964 Leiosteus Gross, 1932 Paraleiosteus (Stensiö, 1959) Coccosteus inflatus Brachydeirus inflatus

facts.statement: Modern classification places Erromenosteus as a basal member of the superfamily Dinichthyloidea.
facts.quote: Now, though, Erromenosteus is considered a basal member of Dinichthyloidea.

facts.statement: Erromenosteus is an extinct, medium-sized arthrodire placoderm belonging to the family Brachythoracidae.
facts.quote: Erromenosteus is a genus of extinct, medium-sized brachythoracid arthrodire placoderm

facts.statement: Species of Erromenosteus possessed bullet-shaped heads and curved jaws adapted for crushing.
facts.quote: The various species had bullet-shaped heads, and curved, crushing jaws.

facts.statement: Fossils of Erromenosteus are found in the Late Frasnian Kellwasserkalk facies in Bad Wildungen and Bicken, Germany.
facts.quote: from the Late Frasnian of the Kellwasserkalk facies of Late Devonian Bad Wildungen and Bicken, Germany.

facts.statement: Erromenosteus lived during the Frasnian stage, between 382.31 and 372.15 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Frasnian to Frasnian (382.31 to 372.15 million years ago)

facts.statement: The holotype for the type species Erromenosteus lucifer is a skull measuring 12 cm in length.
facts.quote: Erromenosteus lucifer, the type species. The holotype is a 12 cm long skull.

facts.statement: The species Erromenosteus brachyrostris is known from a single holotype skull that is 6 cm long.
facts.quote: Erromenosteus brachyrostris, currently known from a single 6 cm long skull, originally referred to E. inflatus.

facts.statement: Erromenosteus concavus is known from multiple specimens with skull lengths averaging between 7 cm and 13 cm.
facts.quote: Erromenosteus concavus, known from several specimens, average skull length ranging from 7 cm - 13 cm.

facts.statement: The holotype skull of Erromenosteus inflatus measures 8 cm in length.
facts.quote: Erromenosteus inflatus, this species was originally referred to as Coccosteus inflatus, then Brachydeirus inflatus, before being placed within Leiosteus. The length of the holotype skull is 8 cm

facts.statement: The holotype skull of Erromenosteus koeneni is 60 mm long, though the name is apparently a nomen nudum.
facts.quote: Erromenosteus koeneni Apparently a nomen nudum, the holotype skull is 60 mm long.

facts.statement: The holotype skull of Erromenosteus diensti is 12 cm long, though it was originally classified in the genus Paraleiosteus due to differences in its scapulo-coracoid bone.
facts.quote: Erromenosteus diensti: its holotype was originally referred as a specimen of E. concavus (=Leiosteus concavus) by Gross (1932), but Stensiö erected a new genus, "Paraleiosteus," for the specimen on account of differences seen in its scapulo-coracoid bone. The holotype's skull is 12 cm long.

rejected.statement: Researcher Denison (1978) argues that the species of Erromenosteus require revision because many were originally described as specimens of other species.
rejected.quote: Denison (1978) says that the various species need to be revised, as many of the species were originally described as specimens of other species.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'were originally described as specimens of other species'
